# ZoomGuru

> ZoomGuru is an AI interview copilot for Windows. It runs as an overlay that is
> hidden from screen share, listens to the interviewer's question through your
> microphone, and writes an answer onto your screen while they are still
> speaking. It works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and any other call,
> because it listens to your microphone rather than integrating with the meeting
> software. It is one product with one job - there is no mock interviewer, no
> document copilot and no scoring tool.

Key facts:
- The overlay is excluded from screen capture at the operating-system level, so
  it does not appear in a screen share or a recording.
- Answers stream a word at a time so you can start speaking off the first line.
- Your CV and the job description are attached to every request, so answers are
  specific to your history and the role.
- No audio, screenshots, questions or answers are stored. Only a record that a
  request happened, and when.
- Windows 10 and later. There is no macOS build yet.
- A free 30-minute trial, one per computer, with no card required.

## Pricing
All plans are unlimited. They differ only in duration and how many computers can
be signed in at once. Billed in naira through Paystack.
- Weekly - NGN 15,000, 1 computer at a time
- Monthly - NGN 45,000, 2 computers at a time
- Yearly - NGN 450,000, 2 computers at a time

Compared with other interview copilots (list prices, 27 August 2026): Parakeet
AI charges $74.90/month and LockedIn AI charges $54.99/month for unlimited
monthly plans. ZoomGuru's monthly plan is about $29 equivalent.
